name: Sprint Create task assign the column
description:
1. Task: make "Create new task" receive and use the column (status) it was triggered from, instead of hard-coding `todo`.
2. Analyzed the flow: `SprintBoardCanvas` emits `{ status: col.value }` → `SprintBoardView.openNewTask` → `SprintBoardModals`.
3. Plan: store `status` in `newTask`, resolve its label/colour via `$storex.chats.statusConfig()`, show it in the info box, and emit it on `task-created`.
4. Also made subtasks inherit their parent's status (`onAddSubtask` passes `task.status`) and kept `'todo'` fallbacks for safety.
5. Delivered full file contents for `SprintBoardModals.vue` and `SprintBoardView.vue` with a change summary table.

messages.content: Create new task will receive the column (aka status) to assign to the new task

## Direct Recommendation Thread the **column value (status)** from each column's "+" buttons through the modal so the created task lands in the column the user clicked — instead of being hard-coded to `todo`. The status is already emitted by `SprintBoardColumn` → `SprintBoardCanvas` (`{ status: col.value }`); the modal simply needs to **store it, display it, and forward it** on `task-created`. --- ## Specifications Table | Concern | Current | Target | |---|---|---| | **Emit source** | `SprintBoardCanvas`: `{ status: col.value }` | unchanged | | **View handler** | `openNewTask(opts)` → forwards | forwards `status` (already implied) | | **Modal state** | `newTask` has no `status` | `newTask.status` (default `'todo'`) | | **Modal emit** | hard-coded `status: 'todo'` | `status: this.newTask.status` | | **Context note** | literal "To Do" | dynamic `{{ newTaskStatus.label }}` | | **Subtask** | always `todo` | inherits parent `status` | | **Accessibility** | icon + text | text label retained (never colour-only) | --- ## Code Examples ### `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue` Only the marked blocks change. ```vue src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue ``` ```js src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue // ▼ add `status` so the task lands in the clicked column const DEFAULT_NEW_TASK = () => ({ name: '', mode: 'chat', status: 'todo', parentId: null, selectedProfiles: [], llm_model: null }) ``` ```js src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue parentName() { if (!this.newTask.parentId) return null return this.$storex.chats.chats?.[this.newTask.parentId]?.name || null }, // ▼ status (column) the new task will be created in newTaskStatus() { return this.$storex.chats.statusConfig(this.newTask.status) } ``` ```js src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue // ── New Task / Subtask ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── openNewTask({ parentId, status } = {}) { this.newTask = { ...DEFAULT_NEW_TASK(), parentId: parentId || null, status: status || 'todo' } this.showNewTask = true this.$nextTick(() => this.$refs.taskNameInput?.focus()) }, ``` ```js src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue confirmNewTask() { if (!this.newTask.name?.trim()) return this.$emit('task-created', { name: this.newTask.name.trim(), mode: this.newTask.mode, status: this.newTask.status || 'todo', parentId: this.newTask.parentId || null, profiles: this.newTask.selectedProfiles.map(p => p.name), llm_model: this.newTask.llm_model || null }) this.closeNewTask() }, ``` Template — replace the static **"To Do"** in the info box with the live column name (keeping a text label, so meaning is never conveyed by colour alone): ```vue src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue
``` --- ### `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardView.vue` Forward the parent's column when spawning a subtask from a card (so a "Doing" task's subtask doesn't jump to "To Do"): ```js src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardView.vue onAddSubtask(task) { // "+" on a card → create a subtask linked to that task, landing in the same column this.openNewTask({ parentId: task.id, status: task.status }) }, ``` No other view change is required — `openNewTask(opts)` already forwards the payload and the toolbar button already sends `{ status: 'todo' }`. --- ## Change Summary | File | Change | Reason | |---|---|---| | `SprintBoardModals.vue` | `DEFAULT_NEW_TASK` gains `status: 'todo'` | Seed state for the target column | | `SprintBoardModals.vue` | `newTaskStatus` computed | Resolves label/colour from `statusConfig` | | `SprintBoardModals.vue` | `openNewTask({ parentId, status })` | Receives column from the click | | `SprintBoardModals.vue` | `confirmNewTask` emits real `status` | Persists to the correct column | | `SprintBoardModals.vue` | Info box uses `newTaskStatus.label` | Accurate, non-colour-only feedback | | `SprintBoardView.vue` | `onAddSubtask` passes `task.status` | Subtasks stay in their parent's column | --- ## Anti-Patterns to Avoid - ❌ **Keep back-compat fallbacks.** Don't do `status: this.newTask.status` without `|| 'todo'` — a modal opened from an older call site would emit `undefined` and `newSprintTask` would silently fall back, hiding the bug. - ❌ **Colour-only feedback.** Don't render just a coloured dot for the target column — the label ("To Do", "Doing") must stay readable, since status is the core semantic here. - ❌ **Mutating shared config.** Never write back into `CHAT_STATUS_CONFIG`; always read through `$storex.chats.statusConfig()`. --- ## Accessibility Checklist - [x] Target column announced as **text label** (`newTaskStatus.label`), not colour alone. - [x] No new interactive elements → keyboard tab order unchanged. - [x] Existing `type="radio"` mode selector remains `class="hidden"` but the wrapping `

history.summary:
1. Task: make the Kanban "New Task" flow receive the target column (status) chosen by the user.
2. The column value is already emitted as `{ status: col.value }` from `SprintBoardCanvas` but was hard-coded to `'todo'` in the modal.
3. Fix: add `status` to `DEFAULT_NEW_TASK`, accept it in `openNewTask({ parentId, status })`, and emit `this.newTask.status` from `confirmNewTask`.
4. Also made the modal's info note show the live column label via a `newTaskStatus` computed, and forwarded `task.status` in `onAddSubtask` so subtasks stay in their parent's column.
5. Kept back-compat fallbacks (`|| 'todo'`) and text-based (non colour-only) status feedback for accessibility.
